leuchtfeuer.title: Leuchtfeuer
leuchtfeuer.goal: The lamp is out. Fetch the glass, the wick and the oil, then light the tower.
leuchtfeuer.notice.glass: The glass is in your bag.
leuchtfeuer.notice.wick: The wick is in your bag.
leuchtfeuer.notice.oil: The oil is in your bag.
leuchtfeuer.notice.guard: The watch sends you back to the beach.
leuchtfeuer.notice.water: The water is too deep. You are back on the beach.
leuchtfeuer.pause.title: Paused
leuchtfeuer.error.assets: The harbour models cannot be reached just now.
leuchtfeuer.win.title: The lamp is burning
leuchtfeuer.win.body: The light marks the way into the harbour again.
leuchtfeuer.controls: Move with WASD or the arrow keys. A click sets the destination. E picks up or lights.
